SIBE Checklist

SWEEP
liquidity taken
I
INVERSE
iFVG confirms
B
BOS
2nd break required
E
ENTRY
confluence stack

Step 1 — Sweep BEFORE the gap matters

I never treat a gap as valid on its own. Price has to take out a real level first — a prior high/low, session high/low, or obvious liquidity pocket — before I even look at what gap it leaves behind.

The level swept has to be real — not a random wick, an actual reference point (session high/low, prior swing, EQH/EQL)
No sweep, no trade — if there's nothing to sweep, I'm not looking for an iFVG at all yet
↓

Step 2 — Inverse where iFVG lives

This is the actual iFVG step. After the sweep, I want to see price reject and close back through a fair value gap with real momentum — not a slow grind, an actual strong candle close through it. That close is what "inverts" the gap into something I'll trust.

Gap has to be sized right — not so small it's noise, not so wide my stop becomes unreasonable
Strong candle close — a real body closing through the gap, not just a wick poking through
One obvious gap — if there are five tiny gaps stacked on top of each other, I'm not using any of them, I wait for a cleaner one or drop timeframes
↓

Step 3 — Break of Structure 2nd BOS only

This is where a lot of people jump the gun. I don't act on the first break of structure after the inverse — I wait for the second one. The first BOS just tells me direction changed. The second is what tells me it's actually holding.

First BOS = information only — confirms bias, does not trigger entry
Second BOS = green light — this is what I'm actually trading off of
↓

Step 4 — Entry confluence stack

By the time I'm entering, I want as many of these stacked as possible on top of the core SIBE sequence. More confluence, higher size. Less confluence, smaller size or I skip it.

Clear draw on liquidity — there needs to be an obvious target beyond entry, not just "it might keep going"

Bonus Confluence — 1min iFVG optional, not required

On top of the 5min iFVG sequence, I sometimes get a second, smaller iFVG on the 1min chart right around the 2nd BOS. This is not required to take the trade — it just tightens my stop and adds confidence when it lines up.

Not required — the core SIBE sequence stands on its own without this
When it shows up — treat it as extra confluence, not a reason to force an entry that isn't there

Bonus Confluence — 13 EMA Cross optional, not required

The other optional confluence I watch for is the 13 EMA crossing in the direction of the trade around the same time as the 2nd BOS. Same rule as the 1min iFVG — nice to have, never the reason to enter on its own.

Direction has to match — the cross needs to align with the trade direction, not just be present
Stacking both bonuses — 1min iFVG + 13 EMA cross together is just added confluence, both are optional

Quick Reference grade it

Sweep + Inverse only, no BOS confirmation yet — not a trade, still watching
Sweep + Inverse + 1st BOS — bias confirmed, still waiting
Full sequence, no bonus confluence — tradeable, standard size
Full sequence + 1 bonus confluence — stronger setup
Full sequence + both bonus confluences — strongest version of the setup
